# B2 Reference Architectures for Voice and Speech AI

> Designs, schemas and runnable examples for storing, versioning and delivering voice and speech AI data with Backblaze B2: training datasets, generated audio and voice agent sessions.

Canonical Backblaze product documentation: https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-ai-machine-learning. Repository pages are maintained as clean Markdown; product documentation remains authoritative for changing service behavior. This community-convention file is a navigation aid, not an access-control policy or a search-ranking claim.

## Start here

- [Architecture index](docs/architecture-index.md): Human-readable index generated from the catalog.
- [Machine-readable catalog](catalog/architectures.yaml): Audiences, workflows, boundaries, capabilities, evidence, security and resource links.
- [B2 capability map](docs/b2-capabilities.md): What each B2 capability does, what it requires, its limitations and which architecture uses it.

## Architectures

- [Voice training data lifecycle](architectures/voice-training-data-lifecycle/architecture.md): Collect speech with consent, validate and review it, and publish immutable dataset releases that NeMo, Lhotse, Hugging Face Datasets, WebDataset and MosaicML Streaming read from B2.

## Contracts and schemas

- [B2 voice and speech AI architecture catalog schema](schemas/architecture-catalog.schema.json): JSON Schema.
- [Voice consent and license record schema](schemas/consent-record.schema.json): JSON Schema.
- [Voice dataset manifest line schema](schemas/dataset-line.schema.json): JSON Schema.
- [Voice dataset delivery manifest schema](schemas/delivery-manifest.schema.json): JSON Schema.
- [Voice generation job manifest schema](schemas/generation-job-manifest.schema.json): JSON Schema.
- [Voice dataset release manifest schema](schemas/release-manifest.schema.json): JSON Schema.
- [Voice agent session manifest schema](schemas/session-manifest.schema.json): JSON Schema.

## Configuration and related resources

- [B2 configuration examples](examples/README.md): CORS, lifecycle, Event Notifications, Object Lock, replication, encryption and scoped keys.
- [Infrastructure helpers](infrastructure/README.md): LiveKit Egress output to B2 and provisioning of per-zone buckets and scoped keys.

## Official product documentation

- [Backblaze AI and machine learning](https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage-ai-machine-learning): Canonical B2 documentation hub.
- [Backblaze B2 documentation](https://www.backblaze.com/docs/cloud-storage): Current product behavior and setup.
- [Backblaze B2 pricing](https://www.backblaze.com/cloud-storage/pricing): Current pricing and egress terms.
